meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows through `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作本地可见应用窗口,完成点击、输入与界面内容读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让程序代替你在桌面应用窗口里手动点击和输入。
copy.tagline_en: Automate clicks, typing, and reading content inside visible local app windows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a program to click and type in desktop app windows for you.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 `orca computer` 在可见的本地应用窗口里做 OS/窗口级检查与输入,覆盖原生应用、外部浏览器窗口等。它先为当前会话选定一个 Orca 可执行文件,再加载版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 当你要在本机可见的应用窗口(原生应用、Chrome 等外部浏览器窗口)里查看或操作时触发。不用于 Orca 内置浏览器或仅页面自动化。

say.text: 看看我当前 Chrome 窗口里显示了什么
say.note: 先解析可执行文件并加载指南,再检查窗口

say.text: 在我打开的记事本窗口里输入这段文字
say.note: 通过窗口级输入操作原生应用

say.text: 确认 Orca 是否在运行,没运行就启动它
say.note: 未运行时会用 ORCA open --json 启动

howto.what_en: Claude uses `orca computer` to inspect and send input at OS/window level in visible local app windows: native apps, external browsers, etc. It resolves one Orca executable for the session, then loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to view or act in visible local app windows on your machine: native apps, external browser windows, etc. Not for Orca's embedded browser or page-only automation.

say_en.text: Look at what's showing in my current Chrome window
say_en.note: Resolves the executable, loads the guide, then inspects

say_en.text: Type this text into the Notepad window I have open
say_en.note: Window-level input into a native app

say_en.text: Check whether Orca is running; start it if not
say_en.note: Uses ORCA open --json when it isn't running
